claim: The 543 benchmark observations cover only 3 bond classes (C-H 302, C-C 240, H-O 1; H-O n=1), while the database taxonomy has 9 classes (C-H 321949, C-C 71166, H-N 27314, C-N 24707, C-O 24354, H-O 11884, N-O 1634, N-N 1597, O-O 302 rows), so 6 of 9 database bond classes have no benchmark coverage.
value_found: Benchmark (543 raw observation rows, independent RDKit radical-centre labeler): C-H 302, C-C 240, H-O 1 (n=1 row: bond_observation_0181, parent CC(C)(C)c1cccc(-c2cccc(C(C)(C)C)c2O)c1O, [H] + aryl-[O]); 0 unlabeled rows, 543/543 assigned, 3 distinct classes. Database (484907 raw rows, DB bond_type column): C-H 321949, C-C 71166, H-N 27314, C-N 24707, C-O 24354, H-O 11884, N-O 1634, N-N 1597, O-O 302; sums to 484907, 9 distinct classes, 0 nulls. Classes with zero benchmark rows: H-N, C-N, C-O, N-O, N-N, O-O = 6. Independent labeler vs DB bond_type on a random 20000-row sample: 0 mismatches.
unit: bond observation (one raw row = one bond): 543 benchmark TSV rows and 484907 database rows (rid unique, no duplicates)
method: python /data/user/conversations/conv-75e3fc1d-c4c9-41b5-800b-05f4632eec99/project/output/verify_8_bondclass_coverage.py (self-contained; does not import output/analysis/common.py; reads only data/normalized_views/experimental_benchmark.tsv, data/source_data/bde_db_full.csv.gz, data/source_data/experimental_source_tables.xlsx)
notes: Exact reproduction of every number with an independent implementation; the 3 benchmark class counts sum to 543 and the 9 database counts sum to 484907. Caveats: (1) Unit sensitivity - 543 benchmark rows correspond to 543 unique (molecule,fragment1,fragment2) keys but only 539 unique unordered fragment pairs and 419 unique parent molecules; counts are unchanged under the (molecule,fragment1,fragment2) unit (C-H 302/C-C 240/H-O 1) but fall to C-H 302/C-C 236/H-O 1 under unique-unordered-pair deduplication. (2) Labeling-method sensitivity for the H-O cell: only 331/543 benchmark rows exist as exact (molecule,fragment1,fragment2) DB rows and their DB bond_type labels are only C-C 187 / C-H 144; the single H-O benchmark row is NOT a DB row (its parent molecule is absent from the DB), so the claim's 'H-O 1' depends on labeling benchmark rows from fragment radical centres, not on DB provenance. (3) Different-unit alternative that could look contradictory: pooling ALL DB bonds of the benchmark parent molecules (369/543 rows have their parent in the DB) yields 6 classes (C-H 2232, C-C 650, C-O 58, H-O 37, H-N 10, C-N 5) - this is a molecule-level DB-coverage statement, not observation-level benchmark coverage, and does not refute the claim. (4) Benchmark TSV keys match the 543-row workbook (Sheet_001) exactly with identical observed values, and observed_value == experimental_bde_kcal_mol for all rows, so the 543-row view is not truncated. (5) H-O label is unambiguous chemically and follows the DB's element-priority convention (my labeler sorted [H],[O] -> 'H-O').
